text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging Sam (oncall). Elevated 5xx rate from control-plane deps detected (auth/org/billing/config). Severity: P1. Start: 2026-03-15T06:06:39Z. Alerts: gateway 502/504 spike, auth 5xx ramp, org-lookup timeouts. Metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/alerts/2705129999

sam_oncall: saw it. I'm on it — joining postmortem channel in 2 min. @maya_runtime can you grab the runtime dashboards?

maya_runtime: grabbing dashboards now. quick peek: control-plane auth error-rate from 0.2% -> 6.8% in last 3m. KV cache miss for org-lookup spiked.

lee_ops: seeing correlated billing service 504s from eu-prod-controlplane. Circuit breakers tripped on some gateways. Rolling window shows increased latency + dropped connections.

anya_prod: customer impact: some hosted-API requests returning 502s intermittently, higher latencies on embeddings endpoints. Support tickets trickling in, nothing major yet but we should notify GA customers.

jordan_sre: good call. initial hypothesis: downstream auth rate-limiter misconfigured during last config rollout (2026-03-15T05:52Z). Could be a new config flag accidentally reduced concurrency.

sam_oncall: assign tasks: maya, can you snapshot runtime logs and tail auth proxy logs? jordan, can you check recent config rollouts and gating? lee, prepare rollback play if config looks suspect. anya/helena, prep customer comms draft.

maya_runtime: tailing auth-proxy logs. snippet: ```
2026-03-15T06:05:58Z auth-proxy[pid=4242] WARN rate_limit_exceeded user=svc-controlplane id=org-lookup-frontend
2026-03-15T06:06:12Z auth-proxy[pid=4242] ERROR upstream_timeout code=504 target=billing.svc
```

maya_runtime: note: many auth errors show `503 Service Unavailable` proxied from `auth-core` with immediate `connection refused` before a retry.

jordan_sre: checked rollout history: config-deploy 2026-03-15T05:52 by configbot — flag `auth.concurrency=50` applied to eu region. Previous default was 500. That looks wrong. Opening rollback PR.

lee_ops: starting emergency rollback of config to previous stable at 2026-03-15T05:40Z. Will update routing after config flip.

incident-bot: sam_oncall acknowledged incident at 2705129999. Pager escalation path: if not resolved in 15m escalate to eng-lead.

sam_oncall: do the rollback now. Also enable temporary client-side cache bypass for org-lookup to avoid repeated failing calls — patching service side to prefer cached identities while auth warms up.

maya_runtime: applying org-lookup cache TTL increase (from 30s -> 300s) on controlplane-edge for eu region. Command: ```kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/edge PROXY_ORG_CACHE_TTL=300 --record```

helena_support: drafting customer message: "We are investigating intermittent 502/504 errors affecting some API requests in EU. Engineers are rolling back a recent config change and enabling mitigations. We'll update in 15 minutes." Want approval before we post.

anya_prod: LGTM, add that the issue may affect API latency and 5xx rates intermittently. Ask customers to retry after few seconds.

jordan_sre: rollback confirmed applied at 2026-03-15T06:12:05Z. Waiting on pods to restart. Watch auth 5xx and gateway metrics.

maya_runtime: auth 5xx dropping already from 6.8% -> 2.1% in the 2m after rollback. Org-lookup KV miss rate also decreasing.

lee_ops: traffic rebalanced and circuits are starting to close. Some throttles still active on billing service, contacting on-call for billing to confirm upstream health.

maya_runtime: additional mitigation: disabled a newly added aggressive retry policy in edge (it amplified load to billing). Command diff: ```diff
- retry_policy: attempts: 5
+ retry_policy: attempts: 2
```

sam_oncall: nice. Keep an eye on error budget. If >1% sustained for another 10m we will escalate to infra.

helena_support: published status page update: "Identified configuration change causing elevated 5xx. Rollback in progress and mitigations applied. Some API requests may still experience errors; monitoring." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2705129999

incident-bot: update: incident severity remains P1 until error-rate drops below 0.5% for 30m. Next automated check in 5m.

maya_runtime: 06:21: auth 5xx at 0.48% — within acceptable range. Org-lookup timeouts normalized.

jordan_sre: closing mitigation loop: config cause confirmed (auth.concurrency erroneously set), rollback and reduced retries mitigated amplification, cache TTL avoided thundering herd. Preparing follow-up runbook entry and a stricter pre-merge gate for auth flags.

sam_oncall: great work team. Post-incident actions: 1) Revert urgent cache TTL change after stability confirmed. 2) Add CI check for config flag ranges. 3) Add canary policy to configbot for auth.* flags. 4) Customer outreach for affected accounts. I'll create the ticket and assign.

anya_prod: creating customer follow-up template now and tagging affected accounts (eu-heavy).

helena_support: summarizing for postmortem: impact window 06:05 -> 06:20 UTC, primary root cause: faulty config rollout reducing auth concurrency to 50, secondary amplification: aggressive retry policy + low cache TTL.

sam_oncall: lowering severity to P2 and transitioning to postmortem channel. If anything spikes again, re-open this thread. :thumbsup:
